comments.author: TempesT
comments.body: There are two quests that you have to do in order to get this one. First one is "An Incorrigible Character", second is "Da Vinci's distress". Both are in Marseille trade guild. To finish incorrigible character you will need Latin, which Italian is an pre-req. You can learn Latin in Syracuse after learning Italian. Battle fame of 5000 is also needed to get this quest.
